slides.title: What can you do now that the old you couldn't?

body.text: Underhook to Head, Waist, or Leg with Hip-Centric Win

items: The underhook player wins by connecting to the overhook player's waist, directly or from his head or leg.
The overhook player wins by freeing a head or leg connection before the underhook player reaches his hips.
The top player wins by standing and touching both outsides of the bottom player's legs.
The bottom player wins by putting the top player on his butt and sitting up, or by getting to closed guard.
The top player wins by keeping control through the round.
The bottom player wins by guard recovery, reversal, or standing.

slides.title: What would you do?
slides.question: You're passing half guard, and you've already cleared your partner's feet. What's the smart move?

options.text: Clear the knees next, then work to the hips.
options.feedback: Right. Clearing it in order is one exact thing you couldn't do before, and now you can.

options.text: Skip ahead and reach straight for the hips.
options.feedback: Skipping the order here usually costs you the pass.

options.text: Stop and reset back to the feet again.
options.feedback: Resetting here wastes ground you've already cleared.
